content_sections.heading: APSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The APSSB CSLE application fee is Rs. 150. Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from paying the fee. Payment must be made online. The notification states that the application fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: APSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 23 November 2026, the application closing date. Age relaxation is available according to the applicable rules. Government servants and ex-servicemen should refer to the official notification for the applicable relaxation conditions.

content_sections.heading: APSSB MTSVacancy 2026 - Post Wise Details
content_sections.text: APSSB has announced 93 vacancies across nine post codes. The recruitment covers Multi Tasking Staff and related positions in various Arunachal Pradesh government departments. Of the 93 vacancies, 70 are listed under APST and 23 under UR. The notification also identifies one PwBD vacancy and four ex-servicemen reservations within the notified vacancies. The PwBD and ex-servicemen reservations are included within the 93 advertised posts and should not be added to the APST and UR totals. Department-wise vacancies are provided in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: APSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for APSSB CSLE 2026 must satisfy the educational qualification and other eligibility requirements prescribed by the Board. Applicants must have passed Class X or possess an ITI or equivalent qualification from a recognized Board or Institution. The notification specifies this qualification for the advertised post codes 38/26 to 46/26. Candidates must be citizens of India and inhabitants of Arunachal Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) under the applicable government order. Applicants must meet the Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe and indigenous tribal language proficiency requirements specified in the notification, as applicable. Educational qualification, age and other prescribed eligibility conditions are determined as on the application closing date. Candidates must satisfy the applicable conditions for their selected post codes.

content_sections.heading: APSSB MTS Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The salary for APSSB CSLE MTS posts is under Pay Matrix Level 1, ranging from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900.

content_sections.heading: APSSB MTS Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The APSSB CSLE 2026 examination scheme consists of one objective-type written examination. The paper contains 100 questions for 200 marks with a duration of two hours. Exam Duration: 2 Hours Question Type: Objective Multiple Choice Negative Marking: No negative marking Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate No sectional minimum qualifying marks are prescribed. The detailed syllabus has been published in the syllabus section of the official APSSB website.

faq.question: Q1. What is the APSSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment examination conducted by the Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board under advertisement number 07/26 for filling Group 'C' MTS and allied posts across various departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 93 vacancies notified for various MTS posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the application start and last dates for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications open on 09-11-2026 at 03:00 PM and close on 23-11-2026 at 03:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class X / ITI or possess an equivalent qualification from a recognized Board or Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 to 35 years as on the closing date of application, with relaxations applicable for APST, PwBD, In-Service, and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a non-refundable application fee of ₹150 for general candidates, while Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website at www.apssb.nic.in before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process and exam pattern for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection consists of Stage-I: Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions comprising General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, and Test of English Language and Comprehension carrying a total of 200 marks for 100 questions with no negative marking.

faq.question: Q9. When is the written examination scheduled for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The tentative date of the written examination is 20-12-2026 (SUNDAY).

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply for Arunachal Pradesh SSB MTS posts regarding domicile and language?
faq.answer: Candidates must be citizens of India and inhabitants of Arunachal Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC), an APST certificate, and the ability to speak any of the Indigenous Tribal Languages of Arunachal Pradesh.
